# TheCalculator.us

> TheCalculator.us offers 332 free online calculators for finance, health, math, science, unit conversions, date & time, and everyday life — plus plain-English guides and explainers on the blog. All tools run instantly in the browser; no sign-up required.

Use this file to find the right calculator or article for a task. Each section below lists key pages as Markdown links with a short description. For the full machine-readable index of every page, see the sitemap.

## Popular calculators

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/mortgage-calculator): Estimate monthly mortgage payments, total interest, and amortization for home loans.
- [BMI Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/health/bmi-calculator): Calculate Body Mass Index with metric or imperial units.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/math/percentage-calculator): Percentages, percent of a number, and percent change.
- [Age Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/datetime/age-calculator): Exact age in years, months, and days between dates.
- [Loan Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/loan-calculator): Monthly payments and total interest for any loan.
- [Tip Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/tip-calculator): Tip amounts, bill totals, and splitting the bill.
- [Scientific Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/math/scientific-calculator): Advanced math functions in the browser.
- [Compound Interest Calculator](https://thecalculator.us/finance/compound-interest-calculator): Growth of savings and investments over time.

- [Finance Calculators](https://thecalculator.us/category/finance): Mortgage, loans, investments, taxes, retirement, and amortization tools.
- [Health & Fitness Calculators](https://thecalculator.us/category/health): BMI, calories, body fat, BMR, heart rate, and nutrition tools.
- [Math Calculators](https://thecalculator.us/category/math): Fractions, algebra, geometry, statistics, and number tools.
- [Unit Converters](https://thecalculator.us/category/conversions): Length, weight, temperature, and 100+ unit conversions.
- [Science Calculators](https://thecalculator.us/category/science): Physics, chemistry, and thermodynamics tools.
- [Date & Time Calculators](https://thecalculator.us/category/datetime): Age, date differences, time zones, and countdowns.
- [Lifestyle Calculators](https://thecalculator.us/category/lifestyle): Cooking, construction, automotive, and daily-life tools.
- [All Categories](https://thecalculator.us/categories): Browse every calculator category.
